name: Audit
description: Owns governed evidence taxonomy, attributable evidence custody, integrity and completeness assessment, retention, scoped review and qualified attestations; not source business decisions, Logging or Observability.

provides.description: Govern versioned evidence definitions, capture policy and coverage eligibility.
Accept or reject attributable assertions and issue independent custody receipts.
Supply authorised redacted evidence timelines and provenance.
Verify evidence integrity and qualify gaps against source expectations.
Maintain evidential annotations, disputes and review findings without owning investigations.
Apply scoped retention, holds, redaction and disposal constraints.
Govern authorised evidence export, import and qualified custody transfer.
Reconcile expected source evidence, gaps and replay status.
Supply qualified intake, verification and control health.
Supply scoped attestations, proof and declared assurance limits.
